title: TRAVERSE '21 Brand Experience
summary: Brand and creative direction for TRAVERSE '21, TripActions' Travel & Expense Festival, and related event systems.
overview: I directed the brand and creative system for TripActions' TRAVERSE '21 Travel & Expense Festival, extending the experience across environmental graphics, registration, stage and presentation materials, signage, digital touchpoints, and related event assets.
